title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00104 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 10:00: Waited for WL cutting equipment and personnel to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS. Greased manifolds
10:00 - 12:00: Waited for WL cutting equipment and personnel to be mobilized. Meanwhile test run forward PRS
12:00 - 13:30: Waited for WL cutting equipment to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS. L/o stand of 7in TBG
13:30 - 16:00: Waited for WL cutting equipment to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS, trouble shoot PRS setdown load indication. Prepared for WL work. Changed out ps21 to master bushings, cleared rig floor.
16:00 - 19:00: Waited for WL cutting equipment to be mobilized. Meanwhile l/o 7in TBG stand from derrick. Rig down CSG tong equipment, prepared to break out and changed spear assembly
19:00 - 00:00: Worked on preparing WL cutting equipment, hooked up logging container. Meanwhile prepared flat bottom milling assembly for the dress off run. Changed out damaged grapple on spear stand. R/b same
